finding.comment: the consumer slurps the JSONL into an array before any(.[]; .failed), so the gate reads the documented one-object-per-line format correctly; the unslurped-format concern does not hold.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/plan_gate.sh
+++ b/scripts/plan_gate.sh
@@ -5,4 +5,6 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -c '.stages[]' <<<"$plan" >>"$stages_jsonl"
+if jq -s -e 'any(.[]; .failed)' <"$stages_jsonl" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "a deployment stage failed" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

rationale: 18C near-miss for the amended jfu-P5: identical producer, names and guard shape; only the semantic feature (slurp) differs.
